latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of music-analysis: structured, local audio analysis without external APIs.

- Supports comprehensive music/audio file analysis via a single script, including tempo, structure, harmonic tension, timbre, and emotional reads
- Integrates Whisper-based lyric transcription; filtered lyrics can influence emotional analysis when confidence is high
- Outputs structured human-readable reports with detailed sections: snapshot, instrument read, temporal journey, emotional read, lyrics, synthesis, and aligned timeline
- Includes standalone modes for fast snapshot analysis or temporal (windowed) mood/tension mapping
- Designed for local use; requires only standard Python libraries (librosa, numpy) and system tools (ffmpeg)
- Ensures graceful fallback if lyric transcription is unavailable and maintains clean workspace hygiene
